rationale: Measured calibration: the founder's own prose scores 0 and genuinely corporate prose scores 100, so the detector discriminates. A delta gate rewards real improvement without making an absolute floor the pipeline's only objective.

scoreSelector.note: Read the number bound to the verdict text. 98.4% and <1% are ZeroGPT's own marketing copy and appear identically on every result.

preconditions: chromium binary present — it lives in a purgeable cache on a volume that has repeatedly hit 100%; reinstall before the probe, never assume
